text:
rachel: quick flag — post-deploy smoke on /v1/embed-prefill in eu-west1 showing intermittent 502s for very short inputs. saw ~4/100 5xx starting right after canary step.

deploy-bot: Deploy summary: release-2026-04-12 started 2026-04-12T11:00Z. Targets: api-prod. Rollout progress: 48%. Canary checks: PASS. Post-deploy smoke: WARNING. Link: https://deploy/release-2026-04-12

kevin: checking logs on eu-west1-b — proxy shows upstream 502 and tokenizer sidecar logging `panic: unexpected EOF in token stream` on a small subset of hosts. snippet:
```
[2026-04-12T11:03:12Z] tokenizer pid=1223 ERR panic: unexpected EOF in token stream
[2026-04-12T11:03:12Z] proxy     pid=4510 INFO upstream=502 route=/v1/embed-prefill host=eu-west1-b-03
```

li: possible warmup/race in tokenizer-v2 after image bump. options: 1) soft-restart tokenizer sidecar on affected hosts, 2) pin region to embed-1.5-stable, 3) hold rollout and rollback tokenizer change. prefer 1 then observe.

rachel: holding rollout at 48%. I'll restart tokenizer sidecars on eu-west1-b and kick a targeted smoke of 100 samples. command:
```
redwoodctl host restart-sidecar --region eu-west1 --service tokenizer --filter host=eu-west1-b-03 --by rachel
redwoodctl smoke run --region eu-west1 --route /v1/embed-prefill --samples 100 --type postdeploy-synth
```

deploy-bot: Action: rollout paused at 48% by rachel. Sidecar restart initiated. Smoke job scheduled.

health-bot: smoke job started: id=smoke-3060606060-1 region=eu-west1 samples=100 type=postdeploy-synth

kevin: restarted tokenizer sidecar on eu-west1-b-03. No config change. watching logs for fresh warmup messages.

health-bot: smoke job complete: id=smoke-3060606060-1 results: 100/100 OK, 0/100 5xx, p95=115ms, notes="requests served after sidecar restart; no regional pin required"

li: logs look clean post-restart; panic not reproduced. recommend holding for 10m observation then resume to 75% if stable. add a canary preflight to verify tokenizer warmup on host replacement.

rachel: agreed. holding for 10m observation window and creating follow-up ticket for tokenizer team to add preflight check. release note blurb: "release-2026-04-12: brief post-deploy 502s on /v1/embed-prefill in eu-west1 resolved by tokenizer sidecar restart; rollout paused at 48% for observation."

deploy-bot: Hold recorded: 10m observability window. Auto-action: resume -> 75% after window if no alerts.
